requirements.description: Enter Demo opens the dashboard without requiring credentials.
Logging out returns the user to the landing page and prevents protected access.
Checking and savings accounts show masked identifiers and USD balances to two decimal places.
Valid transfers update both account balances atomically and create a completed transaction.
Invalid transfers are rejected without changing balances or creating transactions.
Transaction filters correctly apply account, type, status, and inclusive date ranges.
Profile displays only synthetic customer details and does not expose secrets or full account identifiers.
